subject.title: fix(memory): search memory and wiki concurrently for corpus=all (#92633)

question: Should this PR's closing reference close the broader all-corpus timeout issue, or should it land only the concurrency fix while leaving attribution/debug follow-up open?
rationale: The patch correctly addresses additive memory/wiki latency, but the linked issue also asks for more accurate timeout attribution and debug detail that are handled by a separate open PR.

options.title: Narrow Closure Scope

options.title: Accept Scoped Closure

options.title: Pause For Coordination
